CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

2. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

3. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.

4. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)

5. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)

6. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   B. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   D. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   B. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   D. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

9. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.

10. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)

11. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Black, white, and grey

12. Best practice when working on Puppetry: (1 mark)

   B. Refuse all feedback on Puppetry.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Puppetry.
   D. Practise Puppetry with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
   D. Only the costume

14. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Puppetry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Wind Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
